02 / THE WAY I THINKPAST THE HAPPY PATH.
↳

Good software
holds together.

The interesting part starts when the rows begin affecting each other.

I'm a software engineering student drawn to the parts people rarely see: the retry after a lost response, the stock after a refund, the history after a correction.

That same care belongs on the surface. How a page reads. How an interaction feels. Whether the whole thing still makes sense when it gets complicated.

Clear boundaries. A curious eye. Always a work in progress.

01Make the important things explicit.+

Model business states and invariants before adding convenience. Keep the rules somewhere they can be understood and verified.

02Let the evidence do the talking.+

Tests, static analysis, audits, and reproducible checks turn intentions into something inspectable. AI can help write code; it cannot stand in for proof.

03Keep room for a better question.+

Choose complexity when it buys clarity, correctness, or resilience. Experiment with tools, keep the useful parts, and keep learning.
